title: RITES Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 20 Assistant Manager Posts
description: Rail India Technical and Economic Services (RITES) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 20 Assistant Manager Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can also apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their B.E./B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering can apply for the RITES Notification 2026. The interested applicants can apply in online mode.
